aboutData.title: Grace Mussimbi
aboutData.subtitle: IT Support & Help Desk
aboutData.text:
CompTIA Security+ certified technical professional, fluent in French and English, with experience in ticket-driven environments and front-line customer support.

I’m building hands-on IT infrastructure and support skills through my Windows Server and Active Directory home lab, with a focus on configuration, troubleshooting, verification, and clear documentation.

My previous technical work involved investigating issues, working through Jira and support queues, debugging across platforms and data sources, and documenting solutions clearly.

details.title: Languages
details.info: French and English, fluent in both

services.title: Active Directory & Windows Server
services.text: Windows Server 2025 promoted to the first domain controller of a new forest: AD DS and DNS roles, Active Directory integrated DNS with secure dynamic updates, FSMO roles and global catalog, verified with Get-ADDomain, Get-ADForest and dcdiag.

services.title: Windows 11 Client Support
services.text: Workstation naming, domain join and domain discovery troubleshooting, network location classification, and the Windows Defender Firewall profiles that decide which rules apply.

services.title: Networking & Connectivity
services.text: TCP/IP, subnetting, static and DHCP addressing, default gateways and DNS resolution, including the SRV records Active Directory clients use to locate a domain controller. Diagnosed with ping, ipconfig, arp, nltest and nslookup.

services.title: PowerShell & Command-Line Configuration
services.text: Configuration and verification from an elevated session rather than the GUI: Install-ADDSForest, Set-DnsClientServerAddress, Add-Computer, Get-NetConnectionProfile, Test-ComputerSecureChannel.

services.title: Microsoft 365 End-User Support
services.text: Day-to-day Microsoft 365 and Office 365 end-user support, plus SQL and scripting experience carried over from previous production email roles.

services.title: Ticketing & Documentation
services.text: Ticket intake and resolution through internal help desk systems, with request and bug tracking in Jira, documented troubleshooting, QA verification, and escalation when required.

skillData.title: The environment these writeups were produced in.
skillData.text: Everything documented on this site was built on my own hardware and verified before it was written down. No percentage bars, just the environment itself and the tools used to build it.

specs.title: Tooling
specs.value: PowerShell, ADUC, DNS Manager, dcdiag, nltest, Defender Firewall
